# Professional Experience

* ### Graduate Mapping Assistant 
**People Animals Land & Sea (PALS)** | *Aug 2025 – Apr 2026*

I worked with the non-profit organization PALS., where I developed interactive disaster response maps using QGIS and QField. The map was created with three key considerations in mind: accessibility, readability and updatability, as it is oriented towards non-GIS users and Mudge Island residents. To support field-based mapping and wildfire response planning, I worked with GeoTIFF orthophotos, LAS/LAZ LiDAR point clouds, and vector datasets (SHP, GeoJSON, KML).

* ### Graduate Research Assistant 
**University of British Columbia (UBC)** | *Aug 2025 – Apr 2026*

I developed a 10 m fuel type map using an integrated framework that combines a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) with remote sensing datasets, including Sentinel-2 imagery and four reference land cover maps. The resulting map follows the Scott and Burgan Fuel Classification System, representing fuels in terms of fuel load, moisture regime, particle size, and vertical structure.

* ### Ecological Survey and Plantation Management Intern 
**Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD), Hong Kong** | *Jun 2024 – Aug 2024*

In my role as an intern at AFCD, I contributed to tree condition inspections for NGOs, developed a seedling planting guide, and applied geospatial and data management tools, including ArcGIS Pro, to analyze data from Plantation Enrichment Programme (PEP) pilot sites.

* ### Environmental Education Intern 
**World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF), Hong Kong** | *Jun 2022 – Aug 2022*

I completed an internship at WWF, during which I communicated topics related to coral reef and tiger conservation through public talks and ecotours, and developed educational materials and standard operating procedures (SOPs). These experiences strengthened my presentation skills, ability to work independently, and resilience in fast-paced settings.

* ### Field Investigator 
**Food Grace, Hong Kong** | *Oct 2021 – Jan 2022*

I was offered employment at Food Grace to interview restaurant managers about food-waste management practices.  This includes, but is not limited to, qualitative data collection, environmental reporting, and stakeholder communication. These efforts were translated into the sustainability assessment in different Hong Kong districts.
